name: Iconic Drive - standalone version
summary:
Iconic Drive is a driving game about the pleasure of the drive itself. You sit in the cockpit of a classic or modern car and an endless backroad unrolls ahead of you, built as you go, so no two drives are ever the same. Signed junctions lead from one region into the next, through coastal cliffs, alpine passes, Tuscan hills, dark forests, open desert and giant sequoias.

Set off at dawn, at golden hour or deep in the night and let the clock run or freeze it. Rain, snow, hail and fog roll in, and water gather
